questions.q: Who led the Cuban Revolution that took power in 1959?
questions.why: He led Cuba until 2008.

questions.q: Which dictator was overthrown by the Cuban Revolution?
questions.why: He fled on New Year's Day 1959.

questions.q: Which 1962 stand-off over Soviet missiles brought the world close to nuclear war?
questions.why: It lasted 13 days.

questions.q: Which failed 1961 invasion was backed by the CIA?
questions.why: Cuban exiles landed at Playa Girón.

questions.q: Which European country ruled Cuba until 1898?
questions.why: It lost Cuba in the Spanish–American War.

questions.q: Which independence general was called the 'Bronze Titan'?
questions.why: He fought in over 500 battles.

questions.q: Which 1980 boatlift brought about 125,000 Cubans to Florida?
questions.why: It left from the port of Mariel.

questions.q: Which landowner freed his slaves and began the war of independence in 1868?
questions.why: He is called the Father of the Homeland.

questions.q: Which revolutionary attack of 1953 began Castro's movement?
questions.why: The movement was named the 26th of July after it.

questions.q: Which yacht carried Castro's rebels to Cuba in 1956?
questions.why: Cuba's official newspaper is named after it.

questions.q: Which battle in 1958 was won by Che Guevara's column?
questions.why: Batista fled soon after.

questions.q: Who became Cuba's President in 2018, the first not named Castro since 1959?
questions.why: He was born after the revolution.

questions.q: Which Cuban-born ballerina founded the National Ballet of Cuba?
questions.why: She danced into her seventies.

questions.q: Which colonial town near sugar plantations is a UNESCO site?
questions.why: It was founded in 1514.

questions.q: Which US naval base is on Cuba's southeastern coast?
questions.why: The US has leased it since 1903.

questions.q: What is the capital of Cuba?
questions.why: Its old town is a UNESCO site.

questions.q: Which seafront promenade runs along Havana's coast?
questions.why: Waves crash over it in storms.

questions.q: Which valley in the west is famous for tobacco and limestone hills?
questions.why: It is a UNESCO site.

questions.q: Which beach resort is Cuba's most famous?
questions.why: It has 20 km of white sand.

questions.q: Which mountain range in the east sheltered Castro's rebels?
questions.why: Pico Turquino, Cuba's highest peak, is there.

questions.q: Which style of music and dance comes from Cuba?
questions.why: Son cubano is its root.

questions.q: Which band of veteran musicians made a famous 1997 album?
questions.why: It was named after an old Havana club.

questions.q: Which singer was the 'Queen of Salsa'?
questions.why: Her catchphrase was '¡Azúcar!'.

questions.q: Which poet and hero of independence died in battle in 1895?
questions.why: Havana's airport is named after him.

questions.q: Which American writer lived near Havana and wrote 'The Old Man and the Sea'?
questions.why: His house, Finca Vigía, is a museum.

questions.q: Who succeeded Fidel Castro as President?
questions.why: He is Fidel's younger brother.

questions.q: Which Cuban drink is made with rum, mint, lime and soda?
questions.why: Hemingway is linked to it in Havana.

questions.q: Which crop has long been a major Cuban export?
questions.why: Cuba was once the world's top sugar exporter.

questions.q: Which hand-rolled products is Cuba world-famous for?
questions.why: Havana cigars are prized.

questions.q: Which old cars are a symbol of Havana's streets?
questions.why: They have been kept running for decades.
